from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Turn the majority field to 0 and recolor the sparse marks as that field's color."""
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    majority, marked = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    return [[0 if v == majority else majority if v == marked else v for v in row] for row in grid]

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Recolor the background to the sparse mark's color and erase the marks."""
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks = next((v for v in counts if v != background), 0)
    return [[marks if value == background else 0 for value in row] for row in grid]
